evaluation.setup: trained 2017-2019, early-stopped on 2020, calibrated on 2020, tested on 2021

known_limitations: Incident risk during winter alerts is underestimated (predicted/actual about 0.4 in 2021 testing)
Crash data cannot see closures: active wildfires/floods need a separate hazard rule
No hourly weather yet (ordinary rain not visible to the model)
US Accidents reporting coverage grows over time; probabilities are calibrated to 2021 levels
US Accidents severity labels drift strongly across years (major share 43% in 2017 -> 11% in 2021); major model is calibrated to 2021
Incident durations vary a lot by year (70-130 min averages); a single 2021 average is used
Within-place multiplier capped to 0.25x-5x to avoid extreme values from rare alert combinations

route_formula.p_model: incident_model.txt raw prediction, then Platt calibration (calibration a, b)
route_formula.p_major_slowdown: p_incident * Platt(major_model.txt raw prediction; major_calibration a, b)
route_formula.expected_incident_impact_min: p_incident * avg_incident_duration_min_2021 (minutes traffic is affected, not truck delay)
route_formula.unknown_cell: use unknown_cell_log_rate for the model feature, lowest place_rate_2021, overall mean for cell_mean_p, and flag as low confidence

design_choice: Hybrid 2 chosen by pre-set rule: hour-level PR-AUC 0.0328 (model 0.0319, place 0.0272), ROC-AUC 0.9120; corridor-week Spearman 0.716 vs place baseline 0.718.
dropped: duration model: identical results to a constant average duration
